title: How to organise the shoe and boot storage | Mudroom
description:
Holds the footwear actually being worn this season, and gives wet pairs somewhere to drain without soaking the floor.

This is the Shoe and Boot Storage in the Mudroom. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Two pairs per person on the rack, soles down and toes out, one lipped tray by the door holding whatever came in wet, and clear floor between the tray and the doorway.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Bring every pair in the house down to this floor and match them up.
Straighten: One row per person, heaviest boots on the bottom row so nobody lifts them, lightest slippers on top.
Shine: Tip the tray out into the garden and wash it, because dried mud on a boot tray turns to dust and gets walked s
Safety: A wet boot sole on a hard floor is the surest slip in this house, so the tray sits exactly where boots actuall
Standardize: Two pairs per person at the door, wet on the tray, dry on the rack.
Sustain: When you take your boots off, they go soles down on the tray, and when they are dry they move up to the shelf

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Two pairs per person at the door, wet stays on the tray, and the path from the door stays bare.
